item.title: UNINSPIRED
item.description: IT’S OK TO NEED A BREAKOverworking yourself when you have no direction is a dangerous game. It’s normal to be uninspired, unsure, and borderline uninterested in things from time to time. It’s in moments of uncertainty that you need a break the most. Allow yourself the time to recover and recharge. A mini reset will only help you realign and discover what interests you again. Sometimes you need a break to get your spark back.
